system.description:
You are an excellent shot with the bowcaster, and even your most difficult shots are solid hits.

Prerequisite: Wookiee

Effect: Whenever you spend a Force Point to add to an attack with a Bowcaster, if you hit the target, you gain a competence bonus to your damage roll equal to the amount added to the attack.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Rebellion Era Campaign Guide
